**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed)

The agreement contains no non-compete, exclusivity, or field-of-use restriction binding AP. Section 1 affirmatively confirms the opposite:

> "Nothing herein is intended nor shall be construed as creating an exclusive arrangement between Customer and Kubient. This Agreement will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties."

Checks performed: keyword sweeps for "compet", "exclusiv", "restrict", "solicit", and "shall not". The hits were benign — "competent jurisdiction"/"competent substantiation" (p0070, p0041), exclusive jurisdiction and trademark-ownership provisions (p0064, p0065), entire-agreement and third-party-beneficiary language (p0072, p0073), and the confidentiality independent-development carve-out (p0059, which helps us). The only "shall not" obligations on AP are content and advertising-standards warranties, and the restrictions in p0002 govern use of Kubient's platform under the license grant rather than AP's freedom to operate, buy, or build.

This sits at the playbook's **preferred** position, so no change is warranted.
